create.name: Kim Chestney
create.bio:
Kim Chestney is an American author and teacher who has spent more than twenty years helping people develop intuition, which she presents as an ordinary human capacity that anyone can learn to trust and use rather than a rare psychic gift. Her books include The Psychic Workshop (2004), Radical Intuition (2020) and The Illumination Code (2024), the last two from New World Library, and her recent writing links inner knowing with ideas drawn from quantum physics and consciousness research. Before teaching full time she founded and ran the CREATE! Festival, a gathering for artists and creative entrepreneurs, for a decade.

She now runs The Illuminated Way, an online school also known as IntuitionLab, where students can take short recorded masterclasses, a six-week self-study course, a weekly live practice circle and a certification for people who want to use intuitive skills in their own work. She also designs insight card decks used for daily reflection. Her site lists her as a faculty member of the Omega Institute, the College of Psychic Studies in London, The Shift Network and the Edgar Cayce centre, and her YouTube channel carries talks and conversations with scientists and authors on intuition and consciousness.

books.title: The Illumination Code
books.author: Kim Chestney
books.description: Her 2024 book sets out seven keys for developing intuition, drawing on ideas from quantum physics to describe the mind as more than everyday thinking.

books.title: Radical Intuition
books.author: Kim Chestney
books.description: A practical guide that treats intuition as a skill anyone can build, with exercises for noticing inner guidance and using it in decisions, work and creativity.

books.title: The Psychic Workshop
books.author: Kim Chestney
books.description: Her first book, a workbook of exercises for exploring and strengthening intuitive perception, published in 2004.

courses.title: Certified Intuition Practitioner (CIP) Training
courses.description: An on-demand professional training, usually completed in eight to twelve weeks, for people who want to bring intuitive work into coaching, healing or other practices. A more in-depth mentored level is also offered.

courses.title: Awaken: Empower Your Intuition + Live by Your All-Knowing Self
courses.description: Her main self-study online programme, a six-week course of lessons and practices for reconnecting with inner guidance in daily life.

courses.title: Inner Magic: Experience the Power of Your Quantum Intuition
courses.description: An online training in deeper intuitive practice, including work with what she calls the akashic field.

courses.title: The Illumination Circle
courses.description: A small online group that meets for six live sessions with Kim for guided intuition practice, meditation and reflection, with card-deck and journal tools included.
courses.price: $55.55 USD (50% off; general admission listed at $111)

courses.title: Quantum Intuition Masterclass: 7 Keys to Your Limitless Mind
courses.description: A recorded masterclass built around the seven keys in her book The Illumination Code, available to watch straight away.

courses.title: Akashic Field Reading (On-Demand Masterclass)
courses.description: Two recorded workshops of about ninety minutes each on what she means by an akashic record and how to approach reading it for personal insight.

free_resources.title: Online Insight Card Deck
free_resources.description: Free lifetime access, after sign-up, to her online card deck for drawing a card and reflecting on what it brings up.

free_resources.title: Intuition Awakening Guide
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide with first steps for noticing and developing your intuition, sent by email.

free_resources.title: What Kind of Intuitive Are You? Quiz
free_resources.description: A short free quiz that sorts your leanings into one of four intuitive types, with suggestions for practice.
